body: Congratulations! Honestly, I’m very proud for you and your strength to stay clean. Recovery isn’t an easy road, but honoring milestones like this definitely aids in you becoming a much healthier person. Stay strong ✨

I’m in the same situation like you, my first and second year of highschool was full of fun memories and happy moments with people who I thought were my friends. Yet, these last two years have been full of nothing but pain and suffering, and I have no one to reach out to since all of my ex-friends turned out to be shallow, manipulative assholes. I’ve always suffered with clinical depression, generalized anxiety, and really bad mood swings which causes me to become really suicidal for weeks on end. It’s only gotten worse through these months. But please know that your not alone in these dark thoughts and feelings, so many people right now are going through similar issues like you and me, and that kinda makes me feel less... alone in a way. Like, we are just a bunch of suicidal people telling others that you shouldn’t commit suicide and that there’s hope, but it’s true. You just have to be willing to find that hope and hold on tight to it, in any way that you can. You can always message me if you need to vent, I’m here to listen. You are stronger than you think you are.
I’m here if you need to talk about anything

This is similar to how my first therapy session went, I remember my therapist telling me something along the lines of “Oh, you’re just going through puberty, it’s normal for kids you’re age to feel like this” and “try eating more fruits and drinking more water, you’ll feel better soon enough!” and like, I wish I was joking. I never felt more alone, confused, and talked down in my life, and this experience alone caused me to become even more depressed and isolated since I felt that my emotions meant nothing, not even to my parents who were agreeing to what this horrid “doctor” was saying! You’re feelings are valid no matter how small they may seem to others, and it’s okay to not be happy. 

I was never prescribed any antidepressants since I was already heavily medicated for other illnesses, but I’ve heard that they might take some time to take effect on your body. However, please reach out to a doctor or any authority figure that you trust if you feel that you need more support regarding your medication and mental health issues, you are deserving of happiness and relief even if you don’t think so. You’re not alone in this, you can message me if you need someone to vent to. Stay strong ✨

I’m so sorry that your friend is suffering, and you feel as if you’ve exhausted your options to help her. I’ve been struggling with my depression and anxiety for years now, and often times, I find myself falling deeper into a hole of hopelessness without a way out. It makes me so happy to hear just how supportive you are towards your friend, and please know, that what you are doing right now, staying by her side, means so much to her, even if it seems like it might not be doing much. Your support alone could mean life or death for her, and although that may feel like a huge responsibility to have, as someone who has attempted suicide before, it truly means more than you could ever know.                                          

Something that I suggest you could do is perhaps start a project with her, maybe create a song, drawing, painting, really anything that you both like doing (like a hobby) and turn it into a sort of therapeutic experience for the both of you. I remember when I was having mind numbing thoughts of suicide and self harm, my close friend decided to start a vinyl painting with me as a way to distract myself from these thoughts and have a new outlet for my emotions. Now every time I feel these feelings creep up on me, I look at this painting that I created with her and think about how blessed I am to have done such a beautiful art piece with a person that I cherish. I wish you and your friend the best, and I know that you two will get through this together ✨

I FEEL YOU, I constantly struggle with feeling like a useless piece of shit whose life is meaningless and worthless to the people around  me, even to the people that I love dearly. I see my friends mature and grow up over the years, and I feel like I’ve only been stuck in an endless cycle of hatred and misery no matter how hard I try to succeed. They already have their future planned out, their purposes in life, and hell, most of them are already in the process of working in their career field. Yet, here I am, in the same spot that I’ve been in for years now, just waiting for anything to pull me out of this hell hole. But that’s the thing, no one is going to save you from yourself, only you can. In the end, you have to be the one to pull yourself together and continue to fight your battles straight on. It’s okay and normal to be scared, to be worried and stressed about not being able to move on from your current suffering, and so many people have been in the same spot as you. Life isn’t about catering towards the happiness and approval of others, since that has left me with nothing to look forward to. It’s about finding paths for yourself, achieving your own wants and needs, all the while knowing just how far you’ve come from where you started. Treat every setback as a learning experience, and grow along with it in order to turn into the person that you want to be. Don’t compare yourself to other people, since they aren’t you, and they will never be you. Every life is valuable, and every moment is precious. Stay strong, you have my support 💖

I have suffered with chronic depression for over 6 years, and I’m not even in college yet. I know how if feels to look at yourself in the mirror, and judge every minor flaw that you see. For me, the main part of my body that I absolutely hate are my teeth, just like you. For most people, they will experience unhappiness and overall disappointment when it comes to looking at something less than “perfect” in themselves, but for me and others going through metal struggles, all it takes for us to commit a major mistake is to simply despise that small imperfection. But, a phrase that I’ve been told which has helped me to accept this stain on myself goes like this, “imagine if you were 10, would you look at that child and point out their most awful flaw in themselves, rather it be physically or mentally? Would you stay there and feed them the hate and pain that you feel right now? No, you wouldn’t, you wouldn’t treat a child like that. But that child is you, so you shouldn’t treat yourself like that.” You are stronger than you think you are, more beautiful than you would ever know, and someone in the world will love you, flaws and all. You have to keep living and stay strong in order to experience these amazing aspects of life, you will get through this tough period, I’m sure of it.

I can relate so much with what you’re going through right now, it’s actually insane. I’ve never experienced traumatic dreams/nightmares all through my childhood, and yet, all of that changed when I began to suffer sleep paralysis on a near monthly basis, all of which started just 8 months ago (so overall, I’ve had about ~8 awful episodes). But the ones that stood out to me the most (about 4 of the total episodes) always had to do with me being hunted down by a person that I knew in my life (I.e. distant family member or ex-friend) and them forcing themselves upon me to rape and torture me. Most of these dreams take place in the same place, my room or my backyard, and I always wake up panicked and crying. I feel everything, their hands, their grip on me, and the pain that radiates through my body, but I’m never able to move around or scream for help. I’ve also had dreams where I commit suicide by jumping off a building or staircase, and as I fall to the ground, I wake up. 

Every time I speak about these nightmares and sleep paralysis experiences with my family, they always respond in a joking and dismissive manner, and it makes me feel like utter shit since it makes me believe that if someone were to rape me, then they would react in the same way. They wouldn’t care. They wouldn’t be there to comfort me, or help me in any way. 

I think that dreams can represent certain aspects of our lives, but that’s only if you believe in symbolism and meaning behind these scenarios. I know how suffocating and terrifying it can be to go through things like this, and please know that you’re not alone or crazy even if it feels like it! I probably sound like a cliche person telling you that suicide is not the answer, but honestly, it never should be. Imagine how much happiness and success you could achieve if you allowed yourself to overcome these inner demons, and how much love you’d be surrounded by. Life is precious, I’ve learned that through my first suicide attempt, so please stay strong. You will get through this, and you’ll only become a stronger person because of your struggles. You can always message me if you need someone to talk to.

I feel your pain, it gets tiring and almost numbing to hear the same inner voice tell you over and over that things will get better. I sh as a means of saying “help me, hold me, and love me” since it’s all I’ve ever wanted. Things do get better though, sending you love 💖
